newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends at lows on CBOT, commercial sales.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends at lows on CBOT, commercial sales.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended at the day's lows, under pressure from Chicago's soycomplex and commercial selling, traders said.

"All the pressure came from the U.S. We were expecting the funds to buy at $440 and they didn't, so we fell flat," said one trader. Cargill sold 1,200 to 1,500 November. Nov-Jan spread at $4.50, Nov-July $7, Jan-Mar $0.50, Nov-Mar $5, Mar-May $0.70, Nov-May $5.30, May-July at even money. Volume was heavy at 9,700 lots, or 194,000 tonnes, with 900 hedges.
Japan bought 5,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
Flaxseed rose on commercial demand as hedges came in too late to push the market down. November was up $3 at $375.00.
UGG was a scale down buyer of feed barley as locals sold. November fell $0.30 to $150.10. Nov-Feb $4.50. Volume 1,200.
October feed wheat fell $1.90 at $197 on commercial selling at the close, locals covered shorts. Volume 930.
Richardson's sold 50 October and December oats down US$3, US$5 each to US$120.50 and US$122.50 each. PCTS sold 20 October and December peas, Oct down US$0.50 to US$210, Dec up US$0.40 to US$211.50.
(All values in Canadian dollars except oats, peas)
